This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine, dated May 11-17, 2015, features two men in white shirts against a grey background. On the left, an older man with grey-flecked black hair, glasses, and a mustache looks forward, holding a red marker in his right hand. He is depicted behind a transparent pane where a red tic-tac-toe grid is drawn. He has just finished drawing a red "O" over his own face. To the right, a younger man with black hair and a white collared shirt looks toward the center, scratching the top of his head with his left hand.

The tic-tac-toe grid contains several marks: a red "O" in the top-right and bottom-right squares, and two red "X" marks in the middle-right and center squares. The red "O" being drawn by the man on the left occupies the middle-left square.

Large white text reads "TEMPO" across the top. Above it, black text reads "MENGAPA NOVEL DITANGKAP" and "SETRUM UPS LULUNG". Below "TEMPO" is the headline "BEREBUT POSISI BASAH" followed by three lines of smaller Indonesian text. A barcode and price are in the bottom-left corner.
